entities.name: Indigo Revolution
entities.description: A mostly bloodless political upheaval on Avishkar in which the Consulate was overthrown and replaced by the Avishkar Assembly.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane formerly called Kaladesh, renamed by the Assembly.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government of Kaladesh overthrown in the Indigo Revolution.

entities.name: New Culture Collective
entities.description: A political bloc of engineers, students, laborers and other radicals that led the protests.

entities.name: Avishkar Assembly
entities.description: The democratically elected government that replaced the Consulate.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: A group whose former members allied with the NCC.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A reform-minded figure who organized and led the Indigo Revolution.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: A crisis whose handling spurred discontent with the Consulate.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: An earlier upheaval after which the Consulate's functionaries survived.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A city on Avishkar connected to other planes by stable Omenpaths.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Identified by Avishkar as its chief rival in culture and commerce.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: An annual spectacle showcasing Avishkar's culture.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, discontent with the Consulate and aether inequity spurred calls for change, with the NCC leading protests.
events.quote: discontent with the Consulate’s handling of the crisis and the inequitable distribution of aether spurred widespread calls for change

events.summary: The NCC with former Renegades and allies coordinated a nearly bloodless coup that removed the Consulate, organized and led by Pia Nalaar.
events.quote: coordinated a nearly bloodless coup that removed the Consulate from power

events.summary: The Avishkar Assembly took power and its first act was to rename the plane from Kaladesh to Avishkar.
events.quote: The Assembly’s first act was to rename the plane from Kaladesh to Avishkar

events.summary: The new government reformed the class system and positioned Avishkar as a hub of multiversal trade and diplomacy.
events.quote: reforms to the class system were implemented, including instituting fair pay for the servants of the wealthy

relations.quote: Pia was instrumental in organizing and leading the Indigo Revolution.
the Consulate was overthrown by the New Culture Collective and allied factions

relations.note: Identified as chief rival in culture and commerce.
relations.quote: identified Ravnica as its chief rival in culture and commerce
